## Checklist

- [ ] I changed source files. I did not edit a generated file: `prompt/PROMPT.md`, the table in `mapping/MAPPING.md`, or the generated files in `skill/planners-line-test/`.
- [ ] I ran `scripts/build.sh`, and it passed.
- [ ] Every new mapping row is in `data/mapping.yaml` and has an unused ID. No ID is reused or renumbered.
- [ ] I updated `VERSION` and `CHANGELOG.md`, with a reason.
- [ ] The rule's wording is unchanged, or the change is a minor or major version.
- [ ] Every new mapping row has a support label that the mapping README defines.
- [ ] I cited only sources that I opened.
- [ ] The change has no prices, recommendations, ratings, or motives.
